description.ja: • 地球連邦軍の量産型MS。 • キャノピーはクリアパーツ仕様。 • 全身フル可動で劇中のポーズを再現。 • 各武装はギミック満載。 成形品×5、ホイルシール×1、組立説明書×1
description.en: • Mass-produced MS for Earth Federation forces. • The canopy is made of clear parts. • The whole body is fully movable to recreate the poses from the movie. • Each weapon is full of gimmicks. Molded product x 5, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
